description: Receipt sent to a student after they successfully cast a vote in a Student Union election.
subject: Your vote has been recorded — $position
body:
Dear $student_name,

This is a receipt confirming that your vote in the Student Union election has been securely recorded.

Vote Details:
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
Position:        $position
Election ID:     $election_id
Candidate:       $candidate_name
Voted At:        $vote_time
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

What happens next:
• Your vote is final — once cast, it cannot be changed or withdrawn.
• Results will be published once voting closes for this election.
• You will be notified by email when the election is officially closed.

If you did not cast this vote, please contact the Student Union Elections Committee immediately so they can investigate. Reference the Election ID and the time above.

Thank you for participating in the democratic process of your Student Union.

Kind regards,
Student Union Elections Committee
University Administration

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
This is an automated notification. Please do not reply to this email.
